subject: Renewal & throughput alignment for AriaLogix — proposed 12-month plan
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@arialogix.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@arialogix.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal & throughput alignment for AriaLogix — proposed 12-month plan

Hi Samir / Priya,

Thanks again for the productive conversation last week. Per our discussion, I’ve attached a proposed 12-month renewal that moves AriaLogix to a higher monthly committed bucket and smooths the rate bands to reduce per-token volatility as you scale. High-level summary: 

- Monthly committed tokens: 3,500,000 (monthly commit)
- Burst pocket: 15% monthly burst cushion with soft-throttle behavior beyond that
- Rate bands: simplified to three tiers (base / overage / burst) with clarified per-token pricing and an explicit soft-fallback to a compatible quantized variant under capacity pressure
- Billing: monthly invoices, with the option to annualize per quarter if you want predictable spend for finance

I attached RL_Proposal_AriaLogix_v1.pdf with an example invoice cadence and a proposed mutual action plan (MAP) that includes a 4-week onboarding window and canary rollout for any new high-throughput routes.

Can you review and let me know 1) if the monthly commit number looks aligned with your expected Q1 ramp, and 2) whether you prefer a Jan 1 or Feb 1 effective date? If helpful we can lock a quick 30-min call to walk the MAP and the ops checklist.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning timelines.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachment: RL_Proposal_AriaLogix_v1.pdf (pdf)
From: Samir Desai <samir@arialogix.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & throughput alignment for AriaLogix — proposed 12-month plan

Irene — thanks for sending. Quick questions before we book a call:

- Can you confirm what the per-minute rate limit would be for our high-throughput /inference route? We need to ensure our request fan-out won't hit the soft-throttle during peak 8–9am PST windows.
- On the burst pocket: does the 15% reset daily or monthly? Our finance team also prefers invoice after signature — can you confirm you can hold invoice until the PO is countersigned?

Priya and I can do a call early next week if that helps.

Samir
Head of ML Systems, AriaLogix
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>
To: Samir Desai <samir@arialogix.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 08:37:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Renewal & throughput alignment for AriaLogix — proposed 12-month plan

Samir — great questions. Details below, and I’ve attached an updated proposal that spells these out in the SOW section.

- Rate limit guidance: for the proposed bucket we recommend a soft per-route cap of 200 requests/min for your high-throughput endpoint (this maps to ~120k tokens/min under your average prompt sizes). We can provision a warm fleet and prioritize routing to keep latency under the 300–400ms SLO for sampled requests; if you expect sustained spikes beyond that we’ll work with you on dedicated reserved capacity instead of hosted routing.
- Burst pocket behavior: the 15% cushion is tracked monthly (resets at the start of each billing period). Soft-throttle behavior will allow requests to complete with increased queueing rather than hard rejects; overage pricing applies once you exceed the monthly cushion.
- Invoice timing: we can hold invoices until the PO is countersigned; I’ll flag billing to wait for receipt of signed_PO_AriaLogix.pdf before generating the first charge.

I’ve attached RL_Proposal_AriaLogix_v2.pdf with the clarified SLOs, example route configs, and an ops checklist for the canary rollout. If you’re comfortable with the numbers, I can send a DocuSign envelope for the order form and loop Finance for invoice timing.

Related: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/RD-23812 (HubSpot deal)
DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/recipient/--/envelope/ABC123def456

Would Jan 1, 2029 as an effective date work for you? That gives us time to run the canary in Dec and complete a short performance verification.

On call availability: Tue or Wed next week 10–12 PST works for me.

—Irene
attachment: RL_Proposal_AriaLogix_v2.pdf (pdf)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>, Samir Desai <samir@arialogix.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 10 Nov 2028 11:22:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Renewal & throughput alignment for AriaLogix — proposed 12-month plan

Samir / Irene — looping in sales ops and billing to finalize cadence. We’re aligned to approve the contract with the following concessions to help the Q1 ramp: 

- 10% off base per-token rate for the first 3 months after go-live (ramp discount)
- A 90-day grace band on hard throttles: soft-throttle + expanded burst for the first quarter to absorb integration jitter
- Effective date: Jan 1, 2029 (per Irene’s note)

Vanessa — can your team prepare the onboarding checklist and target a canary window the week of Dec 11? Laura — finance will coordinate the invoice hold and issue the first invoice once signed_PO_AriaLogix.pdf is in hand.

Samir — if that aligns, I’ll ask legal to finalize the order form and route for signature.

Thanks,
Karthik
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Samir Desai <samir@arialogix.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Renewal & throughput alignment for AriaLogix — proposed 12-month plan

Thanks everyone — that all looks good from our side. We’re comfortable with the Jan 1 effective date and the 3-month ramp discount. Per finance, we attached the signed PO to this thread to unblock billing. Please hold the invoice until you confirm receipt of the signed document.

Onboarding: Tue, Dec 12 at 10am PST works for the AriaLogix infra team for the canary kickoff. We’ll share our traffic patterns and route configs ahead of time.

Forwarded attachment: signed_PO_AriaLogix.pdf (pdf)

Samir
